Interface NetworkBuffer.Type<T extends @UnknownNullability Object>

Type Parameters:
T - the value type, which may be nullable
All Known Implementing Classes:
DebugSubscriptionImpl
Enclosing interface:
NetworkBuffer
public static interface NetworkBuffer.Type<T extends @UnknownNullability Object>
Reads and writes values of T in a NetworkBuffer, so that reading returns the value that was written. Unlike StructCodec, types are always written linearly into a NetworkBuffer. Prefer NetworkBufferTemplate to build types for records, which keeps both directions in sync.

    • sizeOf

      default long sizeOf(T value, @Nullable @Nullable Registries registries)
      Returns the number of bytes that write(NetworkBuffer, Object) uses for value. The value is written to a dummy buffer, which counts bytes without storing them and cannot be read. Override this method rather than sizeOf(Object), which calls it without registries.
      Parameters:
      value - the value to measure
      registries - the registries for types that need them, or null
      Returns:
      the size in bytes

    • unionType

      default <R extends @UnknownNullability Object> NetworkBuffer.Type<R> unionType(Function<? super T, NetworkBuffer.Type<? extends R>> serializers, Function<? super R, ? extends T> keyFunc)
      Creates a type for the subtypes of R, such as the permitted types of a sealed interface. Each value is encoded as its key in this type, followed by the value in the serializer for that key. Reading and writing throw UnsupportedOperationException when serializers returns null.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the union type
      Parameters:
      serializers - the serializer for the values of each key
      keyFunc - the key of a value
      Returns:
      the union type
